description:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE:

Germany's private pension system is being rebuilt from the ground up. From 1 January 2027, the Altersvorsorgedepot (AVD) replaces the Riester-Rente as the country's state-subsidised private pension and Upvest is building the operational infrastructure that lets fintechs and banks offer it to millions of savers.

Join us as a Working Student in Client Experience and you'll be there before Day 1: helping design the processes, then running them once they go live. This is a rare chance to see a regulated financial product being built from a blank page, rather than inheriting one that already works.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Support our clients: Our partners' support teams field questions from their end-users about subsidies, transfers and payouts. You'll help prepare clear, accurate answers and learn to translate dense regulation into language a customer can act on.

 - Support day-to-day AVD operations: Help run the core processes that keep the product working, e.g. contract registration with the ZfA (Zentrale Zulagenstelle für Altersvermögen), contribution management, the annual bonus application (AZ01), and payment reconciliation.  - Help build the playbooks: As we prepare for launch, we're writing the processes from scratch. You'll help document workflows, build step-by-step guides and error catalogues, and keep them current as the rules and our systems evolve; the foundations the team will scale on.

 - Support error handling and reconciliation: Work through recurring error cases from the ZfA, check that payments and records match, and help spot the patterns behind repeat issues so they can be fixed at the root rather than one at a time.

 - Spot what should be better: You'll see every manual workaround first-hand. We want your view on what's slow, error-prone, or worth automating; and you'll have the room to say so.

description:
HEALTH CAN’T WAIT. 

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture https://alan.com/en/careers. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Employee experience — own the pre-boarding and onboarding operations end to end, and continuously improve the process so every new Alaner's first weeks feel smooth and well-supported.

 - People operations — get hands-on with the fundamentals of HR and be the first point of contact for Alaners navigating day-to-day requests.

 - Individual situations — shadow, then gradually own simple individual situations, learning how to guide leads and coaches through sensitive conversations with care and structure.

 - Learning and development — coordinate and improve our training programmes for leads and coaches, help measure their real-world impact, and iterate based on what the data tells you.

 - Automation and AI — spot what is still manual and should not be, then build the automations to fix it. We use Claude and Dust — you will too.

 - Data and reporting — track key People metrics, turn them into clear insights, and make sure the team always knows what is working and what is not.

 - Documentation — write and maintain clear, user-friendly documentation so Alaners can self-serve and leads can act with confidence without always needing to ask.


PERKS AND BENEFITS

 - All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

 - Delightful healthcare insurance. Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family, for permanent contracts only.

 - Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

 - Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

description:

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. description:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Germany's private pension system is being rebuilt from the ground up. From 1 January 2027, the Altersvorsorgedepot (AVD) replaces the Riester-Rente as the country's state-subsidised private pension and Upvest is building the operational infrastructure that lets fintechs and banks offer it to millions of savers.

Join us as an AVD Operations Intern and you'll be there before Day 1: helping design the processes, then running them once they go live. This is a rare chance to see a regulated financial product being built from a blank page, rather than inheriting one that already works.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Support day-to-day AVD operations: Help run the core processes that keep the product working, e.g. contract registration with the ZfA (Zentrale Zulagenstelle für Altersvermögen), contribution management, the annual bonus application (AZ01), and payment reconciliation. You'll learn how a state-subsidised pension product actually functions behind the interface.

 - Help build the playbooks: As we prepare for launch, we're writing the processes from scratch. You'll help document workflows, build step-by-step guides and error catalogues, and keep them current as the rules and our systems evolve; the foundations the team will scale on.

 - Support error handling and reconciliation: Work through recurring error cases from the ZfA, check that payments and records match, and help spot the patterns behind repeat issues so they can be fixed at the root rather than one at a time.

 - Support our client teams: Our partners' support teams field questions from their end-users about subsidies, transfers and payouts. You'll help prepare clear, accurate answers and learn to translate dense regulation into language a customer can act on.

 - Spot what should be better: You'll see every manual workaround first-hand. We want your view on what's slow, error-prone, or worth automating; and you'll have the room to say so.




WHAT YOU BRING:

 - You are fluent in Germa

description: Ready to take the next step in your career and make your mark in the financial world? At Vontobel, we believe diverse perspectives drive innovation and success. That’s why we’re excited to welcome passionate, ambitious, and curious students into our Early Careers Internship Program. Whether you’re fascinated by finance, legal, technology, and wealth management, this program offers you the chance to collaborate with a dynamic team, receive personalized support, and contribute to projects that truly matter. Over 6 months, starting on 1 March 2027, you’ll gain hands-on experience and insights into the financial industry while building lasting connections in a globally recognized investment firm. What would your role be? As part of the internship, you will: Discover the full lifecycle of structured and OTC products, from issuance and booking to documentation and client setup Learn from experienced professionals across Sales, Trading and Operations, with real mentorship along the way Contribute from day one by supporting real client and business requests in a fast-paced financial markets environment Help coordinate our international white-labelling partners and gain a global perspective early in your career Get hands-on exposure to payment and settlement processes and see how they drive transaction execution Take part in real projects focused on operational improvements and process optimization Bring your technological background and AI know-how: we value interns with programming, data or automation skills who are curious about AI and keen to use modern AI tools to make our processes smarter and more efficient Build a strong foundation in investment products, financial markets and banking operations, a great launchpad for your career in finance What are we looking for? What you bring We are seeking highly motivated students that share our values : Ownership : You are curious and get involved. You ask why a process works the way it does, offer to help where your team needs it, and see your own projects through from start to finish. Tenacity : You are driven and self-dependent. When the data doesn’t add up or the first approach fails, you look for another way and you come back with an answer. Foresight : You are a pro-active self-starter with a can-do mentality. You spot what’s coming and you take the initiative to solve it before it becomes a problem. What sets you apart AI literacy : You use AI tools to research, analyze and draft faster, and you double-check their output before you rely on it. Collaboration: You work well with others and build your network. You reach out to colleagues beyond your own team, learn how other parts of the bank work, and share what you find. What you need to apply You are enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program, or graduated within the last two years, in finance, technology or a related field. You have a genuine interest in the financial sector. You are fluent in English, written and spoken. German, French or Italian

description: Department : Compliance Location : Luxembourg Contract : Internship Duration : 6 months Start date : July 2027 The role ARDIAN is a group owning multiple management companies that are submitted to regulatory obligations. ARDIAN’s Compliance department is looking for a Compliance Intern for its Luxembourgish subsidiary who will: Work with the Luxembourg Compliance team in cooperation with global Ardian's teams based in multiple jurisdictions, in particular Paris, London, Switzerland and Jersey; Help perform AML/CFT due diligences on investments performed by the investment teams; Monitor Ardian Funds’ transfer agents’ activities on AML/CFT customers due diligences; Prepare reports for the Luxembourgish RC and assist him for its reporting to the Funds’ Board of managers; Review of the Funds’ Board of Managers’ agenda and minutes with regard to Compliance topics; Legal monitoring in relation to Luxembourg investment funds; Increase employee awareness toward compliance issues (training); Review and input on new Ardian vehicles established or created or to be registered; More generally, provide other assistance as required on an on-going basis. Required skills Pro-active, rigorous and analytical skills; Excellent organizational, written, verbal and presentation skills; Self-motivated, committed and enthusiastic; Fluent in English and French. Profile Educational background: 3rd year or Master's degree level in Law (mandatory); a background in Economics would be a plus. Strong interest for regulatory framework About the Team The Compliance team is composed of 23 members around the world and is constantly growing. The Compliance department monitors legislative and regulatory developments in the various jurisdictions in which Ardian operates in order to remain consistent with the laws and regulations promulgated by the financial authorities. The team as a global view on Ardian activities and take part to various operational process such as investments and fundraising. The Compliance team is also in charge of communication with financial authorities and monitors topics related to conflict of interest, market abuse, anti-money laundering, anti-corruption etc. Other information Bonus according to profile Luncheon vouchers Application process Please send your application (CV and covering letter) by clicking on APPLY . To enhance your recruitment prospects and prepare for potential interviews, please consult our Resource Center . There, you will gain access to a wide range of advice, preparatory materials, and testimonials.
